ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone that last opened the app before the more-attractions update (SQLite, atlas rows at `a14.p7` or `a14.p8`), open Explore and the walk's ready screen, then walk (Explore on) an area that was read before. **Expect:** every `atlas_area` and landing row is derived again once (p8, then p9 after the audit) with no stall or empty bars; a theme park shows under Amusement parks; a reader who had Viewpoints or Zoos and aquariums off keeps Amusement parks off (MA4, more-attractions audit 1).

ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone, open "What I'm into" in the walk's drawer and in the ready bar and scroll to Parks and gardens, Nature and Zoos and aquariums. **Expect:** Nature reserves (binoculars), Natural monuments (prism), Amusement parks (rocket) and Piers and boardwalks (boat) draw their icons in the KindSwitches, each label on one line at 320 px, and a switch keeps its state after scrolling away and back (MA3, MA5, MA9, more-attractions audits 1, 4, 5, 18).
